name: pinterest-mcp
description: Let your AI agent browse Pinterest: search pins, see images, find similar pins, read boards and download originals. No login, no API key, no browser.
long_description: Pinterest MCP gives your AI assistant direct access to Pinterest for design inspiration. Search pins in any language, attach thumbnails so the model can actually see them, follow related pins, read public boards and save full-resolution images to disk. It talks to the same JSON endpoints pinterest.com uses, so there is no login, no API key and no headless browser. Not affiliated with Pinterest.

tools.name: pinterest_search
tools.description: Search Pinterest pins by keyword, with pagination and optional thumbnails

tools.name: pinterest_get_pin
tools.description: Get full details of one pin from its link or id

tools.name: pinterest_related_pins
tools.description: Find pins similar to a given pin

tools.name: pinterest_board_pins
tools.description: List the pins on a public board

tools.name: pinterest_preview_images
tools.description: Return thumbnails of pin images so the model can see them

tools.name: pinterest_download
tools.description: Save full-resolution pin images to disk

proxy.title: HTTP proxy
proxy.description: Optional HTTP proxy such as http://127.0.0.1:7890, for networks where pinterest.com is blocked
